name: Anpec Electronics Corporation
summary: Anpec Electronics Corporation engages in the design, testing, production, and marketing of mixed-signal power chips and sensors in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides power management; battery management; PMIC; linear regulators, such as single output LDO, DDR termination, and daul output LDO regulators, as well as LDO regulator controllers; and switching regulators, including boost converters, buck controllers and converters, DrMOS, and power module.
